verdict.rationale: First-party docs show LlamaParse can be driven programmatically through a REST API and official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go and Java, plus a CLI. A concrete client.parsing.parse code example is documented, along with API-driven Extract, Classify and Split products and webhooks for job-status notifications. Missing for 10: the probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at any of the candidate paths, the pack contains no detailed API reference (endpoints, auth, rate limits), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of using the API.
